question: Which Indian institution, on 15 May 2025, collaborated with Japan's Sharp Semiconductor Innovation Corporation (SSIC) to successfully test Beyond 5G (B5G) and 6G wireless technologies?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad (IIT-H)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad (IIT-H)** collaborated with **Sharp Semiconductor Innovation Corporation (SSIC) of Japan** on **15 May 2025** to successfully test **Beyond 5G (B5G) and 6G wireless technologies**.
 
• **IIT Hyderabad** is well-known for its advanced research in emerging technologies and has previously undertaken various collaborations in the field of communication and wireless technology.
 
• **B5G** and **6G technologies** are the next-generation wireless technologies that aim to provide faster data speeds, improved connectivity, and enhanced user experience compared to the current 5G network.
 
• The collaboration signifies a major milestone in the development of advanced wireless communication systems, setting a foundation for future innovations in the field.
 
• This partnership reflects the growing emphasis on **international collaboration** between India and Japan to foster research and development in cutting-edge technologies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Beyond 5G (B5G) and 6G Technologies:**

 
 
• **B5G** refers to the technologies that go beyond the capabilities of 5G networks, focusing on ultra-reliable communication, low-latency, and massive connectivity.
 
• **6G** is expected to offer data rates up to 1 Tbps, which is significantly faster than 5G, and will support applications such as augmented reality (AR), virtual reality (VR), and holographic communications.
 
• These technologies aim to revolutionize industries such as healthcare, education, smart cities, and transportation.
 
 
 
• **Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad (IIT-H):**
 
 
• Located in **Kandi, Sangareddy district, Telangana**, IIT-H was established in **2008**.
 
• The institution is renowned for its emphasis on innovation and research in fields like artificial intelligence (AI), wireless communication, and advanced materials.
 
• IIT-H has actively collaborated with international organizations and governments to drive advancements in science and technology.
 
 
 
• **Sharp Semiconductor Innovation Corporation (SSIC):**
 
 
• SSIC is a **Japan-based company** specializing in semiconductor technology, including wireless communication and device innovation.
 
• It plays a significant role in advancing technology standards and has been at the forefront of developing next-generation communication systems.
 
 
 
• **India-Japan Collaboration in Technology:**
 
 
• India and Japan have a strong history of technological collaboration, particularly in areas like robotics, artificial intelligence, and communication technology.
 
• Such partnerships have been supported by bilateral agreements and initiatives like the **India-Japan Digital Partnership (IJDP)**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **5G vs. B5G/6G:**

 
 
• **5G** focuses on high-speed internet, enhanced mobile broadband, and reduced latency, but its capabilities are limited to certain industrial applications.
 
• **B5G** and **6G** aim to overcome these limitations by providing ultra-low latency, higher reliability, and support for innovative applications like autonomous vehicles and space-based communication.
 
 
 
• **Global Efforts in 6G Development:**
 
 
• Countries like **Japan, South Korea, the USA, and China** are investing heavily in 6G research, recognizing its transformative potential.
 
• 6G is expected to be commercially available around **2030**, with ongoing trials and research in many advanced nations.
